profile.summary: Big Green is a nonprofit organization, founded in 2011 as The Kitchen Community, that builds Learning Gardens, which are outdoor classrooms with raised garden beds, in schools. It also funds community food-growing groups across the United States. Its stated mission is that growing food changes lives.

review.notes: Big Green (EIN 27-5083595, formerly The Kitchen Community) is a school-garden nonprofit that Wikipedia places in Broomfield, CO. That matches the agenda's name, Broomfield location and Learning Gardens title. The summary, EIN, website and Denver headquarters (per GuideStar) are supported by the cited sources. The candidate's claim that GuideStar lists a Broomfield address was not confirmed, since the page I fetched shows Denver, but no profile field depends on it. No Oakland-specific page was found.
